name: Hotel Garni Panorama
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Panorama is perched on a quiet hillside in Tyrol's Paznaun Valley in the Landeck district. Its warm, family-run atmosphere makes guests feel immediately at home. In winter, world-class ski domains such as Ischgl are within effortless reach, while summer invites alpine adventurers to explore picturesque hiking routes. The hotel features rooms with private balconies and wide panoramic views, a relaxing sauna, and a daily breakfast buffet.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Panorama in the Paznaun Valley provides hillside bed-and-breakfast lodging with scenic views, a sauna, and quick access to regional ski resorts and trails.
